corrections.corrected_statement: West Virginia law mandates that all motorists driving on the state public roads must carry West Virginia motor vehicle liability insurance with minimum coverage as provided by law.
corrections.note: Removed specific dollar amounts that are unreadable in the provided page text.

corrections.corrected_statement: The law provides minimum coverage for one death or injury and for two deaths or injuries and for property damage.
corrections.note: Removed specific dollar amounts that are unreadable in the provided page text.

corrections.corrected_statement: DUI with serious bodily injury carries a fine of one thousand dollars to three thousand dollars, jail of two to ten years, and a minimum revocation of sixty days.
corrections.note: Added the missing one thousand dollar minimum fine.

corrections.corrected_statement: A second DUI carries a fine of one thousand dollars to three thousand dollars, jail of six to twelve months, and a minimum revocation of one year, while a third or subsequent DUI carries a fine of three thousand dollars to five thousand dollars, jail of one to three years, and a minimum revocation of one year.
corrections.note: Replaced doubles claim with actual fine ranges.

corrections.corrected_statement: Center left turn lanes are reserved for left turns from either direction and are not to be used as through or passing lanes, and you recognize them by the solid yellow lines nearest the through lanes and broken lines to the left of them.
corrections.note: Removed yellow from broken lines because the page says only broken lines.

corrections.corrected_statement: A reversible lane marked on both sides by a double yellow broken line is the only case where a driver may drive for any distance to the left of a yellow line, while a center left turn lane with solid yellow lines outside and broken lines inside is for left turns only.
corrections.note: Removed yellow from center lane broken lines because the page says only broken lines.

corrections.corrected_statement: Railroad crossing signs can be round or diamond shaped yellow with black symbols or black letters on white bars in the shape of an X called a crossbuck, and a sign below the crossbuck indicates the number of tracks when there are two or more.
corrections.note: Removed advance warning and marks the crossing itself because the page does not state those roles.

corrections.corrected_statement: Wearing safety belts reduces the chances of injury or death from collisions by forty five to fifty percent and the lap belt should fit snugly and comfortably over the lower part of the hips.
corrections.note: Removed not the stomach because the page only says over the lower part of the hips.

corrections.corrected_statement: The Americans with Disabilities Act does not require the DMV to fundamentally alter its programs or take on an undue financial or administrative burden, and the DMV will not place a surcharge on a person or group with disabilities to cover the cost of aids, services or modifications.
An accommodation request to the DMV must arrive at least forty-eight hours before the visit, and the DMV may not charge the person with a disability for the aid or modification.
